correctness.rationale: The expansion y_k=|u|^2+r^{2k}|v|^2+2Re(conj(u)v z^k) gives four rows and conjugate-exponential nodes 1,r^2,z,conj(z). Their Vandermonde determinant gives exactly r^3(r^2-1)(1+r^2-2r cos(theta))^2 sin(theta). Setting x=cos(theta), the log-derivative sign polynomial 6rx^2-(1+r^2)x-4r has one root in (-1,0), the other >1. Nonzero endpoint factors and second derivative give only ±theta*, nondegenerate. At r=1 or sin(theta)=0 exhibited distinct rank-one Hermitian lifts share samples. I independently checked the complete signed determinant by symbolic trigonometric expansion, not relying on source checker. Assumptions on fixed r, four consecutive times and iid squared-intensity noise are essential.
